evidence.notes: SOSL Search.query accepts WITH NETWORK IN for fixed local search rows on non-user/feed objects without narrowing Account results.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSOSLWithNetworkTest { @isTest static void acceptsNetworkSearchOptionForAccounts() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Network Account'); insert account; Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ account.Id }); List<Account> rows = (List<Account>)Search.query('FIND {Network} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) WITH NETWORK IN (\'0DB000000000001\', \'0DB000000000002\')')[0]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(account.Id, rows[0].Id); System.assertEquals('Network Account', rows[0].Name); } }
